edges.title: Name change, same forge
edges.essay: Rome naturalized the Greek forge god as Vulcan; Ovid files the equivalence by geography, 'Vulcan by the Hypsipylian land' [37], Lemnos being Hephaestus' fixed address in Homer [1]. Identification of office, documented both sides.

edges.title: The fire goes retail
edges.essay: Prometheus' theft reaches flesh: what was a crime against Olympus becomes a product line at Soho, sold by the yard of horsepower [39]. The routing is literal this time: every reading in the P_energy pool denominates itself in this man's name.

edges.title: Prometheus, unchained by anti-patent
edges.essay: Same act, opposite jurisprudence: fire drawn visibly from the clouds at knee height [40], and instead of an eagle, a refusal to patent. The gift stays a gift because the giver declines the exclusive.

edges.title: The apron and the plough, no rental
edges.essay: Two biographies the young republic bought in bulk. Weems stamps Washington 'Cincinnatus-like' at the plough [15], a Roman mold rented outright. Franklin needs no rental: his Autobiography liquidates the printing business on his own arithmetic, 'I flatter'd myself that, by the sufficient tho' moderate fortune I had acquir'd, I had secured leisure during the rest of my life for philosophical studies and amusements' [40]. The resemblance is enacted and contemporary, not transmitted: neither text cites Livy, and no carrier links Franklin to the Roman exemplum.

edges.title: Postmaster and printer of the exchange god
edges.essay: Crosser of boundaries for a living: postmaster, printer, diplomat, dealer in information as commodity. His section of the Autobiography is a merchant's ledger kept by Mercury's office [38][40].

edges.title: The assigned lot
edges.essay: Hesiod uses pension-file language: the sky is a lot, assigned by Zeus [26]; Atlas collects a set-aside of sovereign order in the form of a permanent sentence.

edges.title: Name change, same empire
edges.essay: Rome naturalized the earth-holder as Neptune; the Aeneid's Neptune rules by Vergil's title-language, 'by fatal lot to me the liquid empire fell' [35], which is Hesiod's poseidonian lot [26] translated into Latin deed.

edges.title: The golden jug run
edges.essay: For the oath protocol Zeus 'sends Iris' with the jug to bring back the great oath [26]; the messenger's throughput is the sovereign's signature process.

edges.title: A mortal woman an immortal son
edges.essay: Semele's promotion is filed inside Dionysus' own line: 'a mortal woman an immortal son. And now they both are gods' [26]; the promotion memo belongs to the father's register.

edges.title: Foam-born to month-holder
edges.essay: Hesiod's portion list gives Aphrodite 'the whisperings of maidens and smiles and deceits' [26]; Ovid gives Venus April as a dividend of Julian genealogy [37]. Same office, different jurisdiction, two accounting systems for desire.

edges.title: Escrow of Olympus
edges.essay: Styx came first to the levy and 'her he appointed to be the great oath of the gods' [26]; the sovereign's covenants settle in her water. She is paid in advance, in perpetuity, which is the tightest contract in the Theogony.

edges.title: The gatekeeper predates the king
edges.essay: Janus regulates 'the goings and the comings of Jupiter himself' [41]; whoever controls access to the sovereign office is older than the office. Rome begins the year at his name for this reason.

edges.title: The sword and the plough share
edges.essay: Ovid's census: Mars was Latium's god 'for that he is the patron of the sword' [36]. Livy's dictator must put down the sword to be legible [33]. The tradition stages the two as the same Roman budget line seen in different reading legs: war is the revenue, the resignation the expense report.

edges.title: The hearth and the tutelary
edges.essay: Both are architecture made god: Servius says no place is without its genius [14]; Ovid's trembling altar of Vesta is that doctrine with a thermostat [36]. The state stores its continuity in a protected center that must never be looked at directly.

edges.title: Founder to office-holder
edges.essay: Both are Roman poses against the same backdrop: Romulus/Quirinus founds with a wall Remus must not cross [36]; Cincinnatus is deputed from exactly such a wall-footprint of dirt [33]. The city manufactures its essential man twice over, once as founder, once as volunteer.

edges.title: The census of patronesses
edges.essay: Ovid's geography of cults files both: 'Juno by Sparta and Pelopid Mycenae, Diana by Minoan Crete' [36]. The Fasti's patroness catalogue is a census of what the state records as productive worship; the huntress holds hers from an island off the mainland's balance sheet.

edges.title: The ancestress launches the founder
edges.essay: The goddess of the month gets her dividend paid forward: Venus's son carries the household gods to Italy [35], and Ovid's calendar arithmetic follows the blood down to the ruling house [37]. Blood is how a goddess becomes a budget line.

edges.title: The city Aeneas does not found
edges.essay: Carthage receives the counterfeit infant while the actual mission walks out the back: Dido 'devour'd his charms' while destiny charts for Italy [35]. Hers is the debt column of the founder story, the city offered and refused.

edges.title: The oracle with the filing system
edges.essay: The Sibyl speaks Apollo's lines and keeps the state manual; the Sibylline books were Rome's constitutional panic button for centuries. The connection is a standard oracle-priestess routing: the god lends the voice, the woman keeps the password.

edges.title: The town named for the goddess nobody built yet
edges.essay: Pallanteum sits on Rome's future footprint named for 'Pallas, his great-grandsire' [35] before Minerva ever draws her Roman salary [36]. The site's chain of title already runs through the goddess of skill, informally, pre-state.

edges.title: Pallas refused
edges.essay: 'Unbred to spinning, in the loom unskill'd, she chose the nobler Pallas of the field' [35]: Camilla selects the war-side of Athena's charter and relinquishes the craft-side. The city's goddess of a thousand works [36] does not always get to pick which department the women take.

edges.title: The guild keeps the name
edges.essay: Hippocrates' flesh house called itself Asclepiadae [3] and sold a discipline whose first aphorism is a disclaimer [42]. The hero-god's name operates the way a license operates: inheritable by the house, revocable by results.

edges.title: The invisible hand is the boundary-crosser
edges.essay: Smith's exchange mechanism 'led by an invisible hand' [43] runs the same circuit as Hermes' barter with Apollo: the transaction sanctifies what neither party intended [38]. Commerce's god has finally been assigned an economist, and the economist reports no one is in charge.

edges.title: The partner holds the pen
edges.essay: Watt improved the engine; Boulton named the product. 'I sell here, Sir, what all the world desires to have--POWER' was Boulton's voice to Boswell, 'father to his tribe' of seven hundred [39]. The fire goes retail through the partnership, and the salesman collects history's commission.

edges.title: The brother who would not hide
edges.essay: Hector rebukes Paris for the war his carrying-off wages; the conflict edge is within the family, Troy's perimeter holding its own cause accountable [1].

edges.title: The mother petitions the summit
edges.essay: Thetis climbs to Olympus and puts her son's honor on the king's agenda [1]; the favor Zeus owes her is one of the oldest debts of his accession, and the war's course is her calling it in.

edges.title: The estate of Peleus flagged mortal
edges.essay: The immortal team was given to Peleus on his wedding, and the gift's fine print is mortality: attached to a mortal account, even undying horses accrue grief [1].

edges.title: War scheduled out of the room
edges.essay: Athena to Ares: 'may we not now leave the Trojans and Achaeans to fight it out' [1]. Ovid will translate the same desk-power to the Roman register: 'fierce wars are waged by Minerva's hands' [36]. Minerva runs war's office; Ares rents the field.

edges.title: The ransom is memorial, not metal
edges.essay: Priam buys Hector's body with the price of standing in for Achilles' father [1]; the exchange is one father-figure for a son's corpse, weighted in filial arithmetic.

edges.title: The prior king with impeccable paperwork
edges.essay: Latinus's pedigree runs Saturn to Faunus to him [35]; his function in the founder system is the waiting landlord whose title the myth requires the hero to marry. His daughter's betrothal is the deed transfer.

edges.title: The Titan becomes curriculum
edges.essay: Iopas 'sung what ancient Atlas taught' [35]: celestial mechanics as after-dinner repertoire. The Titan's sentenced posture is converted into dining-room astronomy, which is how condemned labor survives as high culture.

edges.title: Victory-Fame, indivisible twin
edges.essay: Brumidi pairs 'Liberty and Victory/Fame' at Washington's side [16]; Vergil's Fama is the last-born Titan who grows from pigmy to skyhead [35]. The American cult's tutelary twin is Rome's rumor-daimon, installed there by the state as if unawares.

edges.title: Drowned king, national river
edges.essay: Tiberinus becomes the state's waterway by drowning into it [37]; Washington becomes the building's tutelary by being suspended by the legislature [16]. Both are officials absorbed into infrastructure, name kept on the brass plate.

edges.title: The city as the god
edges.essay: Pericles offers Athens as 'the school of Hellas' [44]; Minerva's Quinquatrus made the school the goddess's tithe zone [36]. The flesh-record statesman packages the polis itself as the cult object for which the dead are payment.

edges.title: The sixteenth day, not scheduled
edges.essay: FDR asks Congress for 'broad Executive power to wage a war against the emergency' equal to repelling an invasion [45]; Cinccinatus got exactly that power and gave it back on the sixteenth day [33]. The graph records both scripts; the loan instruments are identical, the repayment terms not.

edges.title: The office projects the founders
edges.essay: The presidency inherits the tutelary's furniture: the office Washington organized is the office FDR asks to expand toward war footing [45]. The share routed is the national pool itself.

edges.title: Grandfathered in all three jurisdictions
edges.essay: 'The son of Cronos did her no wrong nor took anything away' [26]: the redistribution of Olympus stops at her file. She collects from the sovereign order precisely because the order could not collect from her.

edges.title: Mother of the house songbook
edges.essay: The Muses who praise Zeus's distributions are Mnemosyne's daughters [26]; the court's memory department is married into the throne, and the chronicle sings accordingly.

edges.title: Both price the gift of gods to mortals
edges.essay: Thetis counts the span, Zeus counts the grief-loan terms on the horses [1]; both notes state that immortality attached to flesh record is not advantage, only accounting.

edges.title: The brothers decline the war
edges.essay: Helen herself assigns their absence its motive: 'for the shame and disgrace that I have brought upon them' [1]. The twin gods of the horse-race withdraw from the Trojan account as reputational risk.

edges.title: The last firewall test
edges.essay: Earth's youngest almost took the throne: 'he would have come to reign... had not the father of men and gods been quick to perceive it' [26]. The conflict line is the annealing moment of Zeus's power; after the spike there are no more contenders.

edges.title: The tree is the gallows-library
edges.essay: Odin hangs 'on a wind-rocked tree... to Odin offered, myself to myself' [46]; the world-tree serves here as instrument of self-extraction, the branch on which knowledge is bartered from one's own body.

edges.title: Tools against the costs of flesh
edges.essay: Thor's entire function is the hammer that answers the giants,and Völund's smith-work is the Edda's other documented product line of tool-power [24][46]. The tradition's arms makers and arms wielders sit closer together than the saga's axes say.

edges.title: The one death the healers cannot bill
edges.essay: Baldr falls to the plant overlooked in the inventory [46]; Machaon's line ends under the same arithmetic of the one wound no healer was counted worth [3]. Both gods store the lesson that the healable world stops at its chosen exception.

edges.title: The liability walks beside the asset
edges.essay: The Edda pairs them as expedition partners who cannot be discharged: Loki's progeny fills the apocalypse roster [46], and Thor's last assignment is one of Loki's entries. Conflict here is priced as joint tenancy.

edges.title: Twin lines of the hoard
edges.essay: The Vanir siblings split the household portfolio: his office is unbinding [46], hers is the gold that flows when the husband leaves [46]. Between them the fertility economy is complete:release below, liquidity above.

edges.title: The horn is stored with the pledge
edges.essay: The trumpet waits under the world-tree, collateral beside Odin's forfeited deposit [46]; the watchman's alarm is pre-funded by the father's body. Surveillance as trust instrument.

edges.title: The amulet with the surname rider
edges.essay: The small golden Apollo went bosom-carried into battle, addressed by name as the client-stabilizer: 'Fortunate Cornelius Sylla' rents the Pythian against every campaign outcome [47]. The client's trust is a contract affirmed in threats: 'wilt thou now cast him down?' The god's answer is the only one on record that is read as loyalty. The naming-rights deal outlasts the battlefield.

edges.title: The resignation that proves nothing
edges.essay: Both men leave the dictatorship alive, and that is the entire contrast: the office returned at day sixteen is the Republic's founding proof of the rule [33]; the office returned after the proscriptions is the counter-proof that the office itself had already changed the man holding it [48]. Each resignation narrates the other.

edges.title: The surname of the ascribed line
edges.essay: Galen files Hippocrates as the correct fork in the elder schism: nature artistic and equitable rather than atomic chance [53]. The Asclepiadae descent [3] becomes a theory of matter; kinship here is doctrinal inheritance, the family brand kept as physics.

edges.title: The desk half of war extended
edges.essay: Minerva's fasti file includes the school-fees line and the hundred crafts; the Royal Society register is the same office, motions recorded 'as well as' campaigns further south and war-machines unwritten [50][36]. The goddess who collects the pennies also collects the calculus.

edges.title: The kite becomes the motor
edges.essay: Franklin bottled the sky's electricity [40]; Faraday's diary converts magnetism into that electricity on demand [51]. The transmission is laboratory-thick: same fire, metered by persistence, devices instead of gifts.

edges.title: Crumbs into currents
edges.essay: Ampère abstracts counting out of biscuit crumbs [49]; Faraday magnets current out of coils [51]. The units interconvert because the men hold pieces of the same table. The SI assigns their names to quantities that still resemble the kitchen supplies.

edges.title: The audit of power
edges.essay: Five hundred-plus foot-pounds per unit of heat [52]; power sold 'what all the world desires' [39]. Joule provides the conversion table in which Watt's retail commodity is denominated; the two units are conjugate in every modern bill of lading for heat and work.

edges.title: The last wife
edges.essay: Hesiod's list of the sovereign's consorts closes with the one who shares the throne-name: 'Lastly, he made Hera his blooming wife' [26]. The marriage is registered last because it sticks; the tradition files the earlier unions as procurements and this one as co-tenancy of Olympus. ([26] Theogony, ll. 921-923)

edges.title: Born of the quarrel
edges.essay: Answer to the head-birth: Zeus brings forth Athene alone from his skull, 'But Hera without union with Zeus, for she was very angry and quarrelled with her mate, bare famous Hephaestus, who is skilled in crafts more than all the sons of Heaven' [26]. The forge on Olympus is the wife's entry in the rivalry of self-sufficient birth. ([26] Theogony, ll. 924-929)

edges.title: The lame husband
edges.essay: Demodocus sings it as common knowledge: the intrigue of Ares and Aphrodite 'in the house of Vulcan', 'King Vulcan's marriage bed' [54]. The Odyssey's divine household pairs the craft-god's throne with desire's, and the mismatch is the joke the whole pantheon attends in person. ([54] Od. 8.267ff)

edges.title: The invisible net
edges.essay: Alerted by the Sun, the smith 'got his great anvil into its place, and began to forge some chains which none could either unloose or break', festoons the bed 'all over with chains like cobwebs', and holds Ares fast until ransom terms are settled [54]. Craft triumphs over war once, in the court poem, and collects bail from the sea. ([54] Od. 8.272ff)

edges.title: The adultery sung at court
edges.essay: 'The loves of Mars and Venus, and how they first began their intrigue in the house of Vulcan' [54]: Homer's boldest divine episode assigns the war-god desire and shows both published by the Sun, netted by the smith, and bailed by the sea. The tradition likes them together precisely as an exposure story. ([54] Od. 8.266ff)

edges.title: Thrice beaten from the wall
edges.essay: At Troy's wall the rampage of Patroclus meets no proxy: 'thrice did Patroclus charge at an angle of the high wall, and thrice did Apollo beat him back, striking his shield with his own immortal hands' [1]. The horse Xanthus later gives the autopsy of the aristeia's end: it was 'the mighty god whom lovely Leto bore' that slew Patroclus and 'vouchsafed a triumph to Hector' [1]. Apollo is the creditor who moves against Achilles' house in two installments: the friend first, then his own death's foretelling. ([1] Il. 16.698ff; Il. 19.404ff)

edges.title: Censors of the speaking horse
edges.essay: Granted a human voice by Hera, Xanthus prophesies his master's death, and the permission has a limit: 'When he had thus said the Erinyes stayed his speech' [1]. Even a dispensation from Olympus answers to the old licenses; the speaking animal is silenced by the powers of curse and due measure. ([1] Il. 19.418)

edges.title: The queen rents Allecto
edges.essay: When fate will not bar the Trojan from Italy, Juno procures the war from below: she descends to the Stygian flood, raises the Fury Allecto, and the poem sneers its own receipt, 'An act that well became the wife of Jove' [35]. The tutelary of women financing a vendetta with the underworld's barrister: the Greek curse-demons at Roman state retainers. ([35] Aen. 7.286ff, 7.323ff)
